name: Salesforce (CRM platform)
sku: Salesforce CRM applications and their REST API. Data Cloud, Tableau Next and Agentforce are not scored.

source.saas-api.note: Holds business records such as accounts and custom objects, and exposes them through a REST API that reads object metadata, queries and searches, and creates, updates and deletes records over standard HTTP.

presentation.tagline: CRM applications whose customer records reach the stack through APIs.
